messages:
maria: Ran a quick cross-region micro-benchmark for the reranker/embedding path. Comparing GPU vs CPU + coldstart/proxy effects. Summary below.

maria: Test config: model=rerank-v2 (768 dim), fp16 on GPU, bf16 on CPU where possible. workloads: batch sizes [1,8,32,64], synthetic queries, 10k requests/region.

maria: Command (kinda):
```
$ bench-run --model rerank-v2 --dims 768 --batch 64 --rate 200 --region eu-west1 --backend gpu --quant fp16 --warmup 200
```

raj: Nice. Did you include proxying (model proxy) in the path or direct to runtime?

maria: Included proxying layer (our edge proxy) by default, and a direct-to-runtime run to isolate impact. Coldstart was tested by cycling node pool between runs.

olivia: Any numbers? p50/p95 and throughput would be great.

maria: Paste of the short table from the run (p50/p95 in ms, QPS measured):
```
Region   Path      Backend  Batch QPS  p50  p95  notes
us-east  Proxy     GPU     64    118  12ms 30ms  cublasA kernel, warm cache
us-east  Direct    GPU     64    132  10ms 22ms  bypass proxy
us-east  Proxy     CPU     64     22  48ms 130ms numa + kernel mismatch
eu-west  Proxy     GPU     64    105  14ms 34ms  PCIe x16 slightly higher tail
ap-south Proxy     GPU     16     27  28ms 92ms  lower PCIe, smaller batch
ap-south Proxy     CPU     16      6 120ms 380ms severe tail under load
```

maria: Key observations: GPU always gives >4-6x QPS vs CPU for this workload. Proxy adds ~10-20% p95 overhead but can cause spikes on coldstart due to cache miss and model init. APAC shows worse tail due to network+PCIe gen.

sam: Did you try int8 quant (dynamic) on CPU or GPU? How's quality/latency tradeoff?

maria: Quick int8 check on GPU (tf32->int8 sim): QPS +20% for batch>=32, p95 improves slightly for steady-state but coldstart jitter larger. Need downstream eval for quality. CPU int8 gave negligible perf gain because GEMM kernels aren't optimized for our shapes.

raj: For capacity planning: based on those QPS numbers, a single GPU (80GB) node at us-east steady-state handles ~120 QPS at batch 64, so plan ~10k QPS -> ~85 nodes with headroom. CPU nodes would need ~5x the instance count.

olivia: For production we should: 1) prewarm model proxies for low-latency paths, 2) pin small number of warm nodes in APAC, 3) enable batching heuristics in proxy for eu/us.

maria: Agreed. Also want to try kernel switch: cudnnA vs custom attention kernels on large batches. Early signal: custom kernel reduces p95 by ~6ms on batch>=64.

infra-bot: Deploy note: can submit canary to us-east with proxy prewarm flag enabled: /deploy canary rerank-v2 us-east prewarm=true

sam: One more ask: can you dump perf counters (PCIe BW, kernel occupancy) for the ap-south run? I want to correlate tail with PCIe saturation.

maria: Will upload counters and a small flame graph in the follow-up thread. For now, pushing recommended ops to product: prefer GPU for latency-sensitive rerank, CPU only as cold fallback or for cheaper large-batch offline reranks. :thumbsup:

raj: Nice work, short and actionable. If you post the perf counters I'll open a follow-up for kernel tuning.

maria: Thanks — will post artifacts in ~1h.
